headline: Modine Reports Q2 Fiscal 2027 Results and Raises Full-Year Outlook
summary: Modine reported its second-quarter fiscal 2027 results, driven by strong growth in Data Centers and Commercial HVAC. The company also raised its full-year revenue outlook for its core business.
why: Modine Manufacturing Company provides thermal management products and solutions globally, with a focus on heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and data center cooling infrastructure.

impacts.name: Modine Manufacturing Company
